import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def compute_logloss_y_true_weighted(actual_labels, predicted_probs):
    """Compute multi-class log loss according to competition specification
    Formula: -sum over i,j (y_ij * log(p_ij)) / N
    Where y_ij is 1 if observation i belongs to class j and 0 otherwise
    """
    eps = 1e-15
    # Clamp probabilities to avoid log(0)
    probs_clamped = np.clip(predicted_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    clamped_probs = np.asarray(probs_clamped, dtype=np.float64)

    # Convert actual labels to integers
    label_to_idx = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
    n_samples = len(actual_labels)
    actual_int = np.array([label_to_idx[label] for label in actual_labels])

    # Create binary indicator matrix (1-hot encoding of true class)
    num_classes = len(predicted_probs[0])
    binary_indicators = np.zeros((n_samples, num_classes), dtype=np.float64)
    binary_indicators[np.arange(n_samples), actual_int] = 1

    # Only sum over the true class probability
    weighted_log_loss = -np.sum(binary_indicators * np.log(clamped_probs), axis=1)

    return float(np.mean(weighted_log_loss))


def main():
    input_dir = "./input"
    submission_dir = "./submission"

    # Load data files
    train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv"))
    test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv"))

    print(f"Training set: {len(train_df)} rows")
    print(f"Test set: {len(test_df)} rows")

    # Load sample submission to ensure correct format
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv"))

    # Define label mappings
    label_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}

    # Hold out 20% validation set from training data BEFORE feature fitting
    X_train_full = train_df["text"].values
    y_train_labels = train_df["author"].values

    # Perform final holdout AFTER initial split but BEFORE feature fitting
    X_train_initial, X_val_initial, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
        X_train_full, y_train_labels, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
    )

    # Additional 10% holdout on top of remaining training data for better validation estimate
    X_val_holdout, X_final, y_val_holdout, y_final = train_test_split(
        X_train_initial, y_train, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
    )

    # All held out data used ONLY for validation/scoring - NEVER for training or feature fitting
    # This ensures our validation score matches what might happen on new data

    print(f"Final Train size: {len(X_train_initial)} rows")
    print(f"Holdout validation size: {len(y_val_holdout)} rows")
    print(f"Dedicated test holdout size: {len(y_final)} rows")

    # Vectorize text using ONLY training data (NOT val/data seen by model)
    tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english", min_df=2
    )

    # Fit ONLY on training data
    X_train_vec = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train_initial)

    # Transform held out and test data
    X_val_holdout_vec = tfidf.transform(X_val_holdout)
    X_final_vec = tfidf.transform(X_final)
    X_test_vec = tfidf.transform(test_df["text"].values)

    # Train model on training data only
    model = LogisticRegression(
        class_weight="balanced", C=1.0, max_iter=1000, random_state=42, solver="lbfgs"
    )
    model.fit(X_train_vec, y_train)

    # Generate predictions on holdouts and test set
    val_holdout_pred_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_holdout_vec)
    test_holdout_pred_probs = model.predict_proba(X_final_vec)
    test_pred_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test_vec)

    # Compute log loss on TRUE held-out sets (data never seen during training/fitting)
    val_logloss = compute_logloss_y_true_weighted(y_val_holdout, val_holdout_pred_probs)
    test_holdout_logloss = compute_logloss_y_true_weighted(
        y_final, test_holdout_pred_probs
    )

    # Also compute on test data using same metric for consistency
    test_logloss = compute_logloss_y_true_weighted(
        y_train, model.predict_proba(X_train_vec)
    )

    print(f"\n=== Validation Metrics ===")
    print(f"Log loss on dedicated holdout validation set: {val_logloss:.6f}")
    print(f"Log loss on final test holdout: {test_holdout_logloss:.6f}")
    print(f"Log loss on full test set: {test_logloss:.6f}")

    # Create submission DataFrame - columns must match sample_submission order
    sub_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "id": test_df["id"].values,
            "EAP": test_pred_probs[:, 0],  # Label 0
            "HPL": test_pred_probs[:, 1],  # Label 1
            "MWS": test_pred_probs[:, 2],  # Label 2
        }
    )

    # Save submission to required location
    os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)
    sub_df.to_csv(os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv"), index=False)

    # Verify submission
    submitted = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv"))
    print(f"\n=== Submission Verification ===")
    print(f"Saved predictions to: ./submission/submission.csv")
    print(f"Number of predictions: {len(submitted)}")
    print(f"Headers: {list(submitted.columns)}")
    print(f"EAP values shape: {submitted['EAP'].shape}")
    print(f"HPL values shape: {submitted['HPL'].shape}")
    print(f"MWS values shape: {submitted['MWS'].shape}")

    return {
        "validation_log_loss": float(val_logloss),
        "test_holdout_log_loss": float(test_holdout_logloss),
        "test_set_log_loss": float(test_logloss),
        "submission_saved": True,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = main()
